title: .chats.json5 — project chat bindings
description: Maps a project working directory to the Matrix rooms/spaces and Telegram chats/groups where discussion around that code happens. JSON5 files are parsed first, then validated against this schema (e.g. with ajv). telegram.topics is the forum-group discriminator: present = group with topics, absent = plain group.

project.description: Project name, usually the repo directory name.

telegram.description: Telegram binding. topics present = forum/supergroup with topics; topics absent = plain group without topics.

topics.description: Forum topics of the group. Omit the key entirely for groups without topics.

id.description: message_thread_id. 1 = the implicit General topic (Telegram omits message_thread_id on General messages).

general.description: true for the implicit General topic.
